items.hed: Texans fall 13-16 at Carolina in the preseason finale
items.insight: Club schedule lists Friday at Bank of America Stadium final, L 13-16. Carolina’s site has the same 16-13. Starters sat. Marc Vandermeer writes the 53-man roster is due Sunday, and the games that count start Sept. 13 at home against Buffalo.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium interior. Venue still, not a game photo.

items.hed: Astros at the Mets again, first pitch 4:10 ET
items.insight: Houston is 68-67 after a 3-1 win Friday at Citi Field. Hunter Brown struck out 10 over 6 2/3 innings. Saturday’s game at Citi Field is scheduled for 4:10 p.m. ET. Two games remain in the series.
items.image_caption: Minute Maid Park / Daikin Park, 2010 offseason. Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0. Venue still.

items.hed: Rockets open at home vs. Dallas on Oct. 21
items.insight: The published slate still stands: regular season opens Oct. 21 at home against Dallas, then San Antonio at Austin’s Moody Center Oct. 23. Twenty-one national-TV games. Preseason China Games vs. Dallas Oct. 9 and 11.
